title: Reducing Safety Margin to Increase Speed
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to move closer to the obstacles, potentially increasing its speed and reducing the time to traverse the chicane.
mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot can approach the obstacles more closely, which can be beneficial for faster traversal.
